text:
The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

Here is the analysis of the sentence structure for the provided text: "Whales, the largest mammals on Earth, sing to communicate."

1. **Whales** - Noun (Subject)
2. **,** - Punctuation
3. **the** - Determiner (Article)
4. **largest** - Adjective (Superlative)
5. **mammals** - Noun (Appositive)
6. **on** - Preposition
7. **Earth** - Noun (Object of the preposition)
8. **,** - Punctuation
9. **sing** - Verb (Predicate)
10. **to** - Particle (Part of the infinitive)
11. **communicate** - Verb (Infinitive)
